captured_black.note: Count of black stones captured by white

captured_white.note: Count of white stones captured by black

capture.definition: a group of connected same-color stones with no empty adjacent intersections (liberties) is captured
capture.effect: remove captured group from board; increment captor prisoner count

suicide.definition: placing a stone that would leave own group with zero liberties after resolving opponent captures
suicide.constraint: forbidden unless placement captures at least one opponent group

ko.definition: board position must not repeat the immediately previous board state
ko.constraint: placement that recreates the previous board position is forbidden

pass.definition: a player may pass instead of placing a stone
pass.effect: turn passes to opponent with no board change

komi.definition: white receives 6.5 points compensation for moving second

scoring.definition: territory (empty intersections enclosed by one color) plus prisoners captured; white adds komi
scoring.note: Japanese rules by default; Chinese area scoring is an alternative
